posts.body:
hi everyone

i have been looking at buying a pushchair after the first one i purchased doesn't fit in the boot well (mothercare xcursion) its way to long and will only go in on the angle which means you cant get anything else in the boot

so ive been looking at the silver cross linear freeway .... we have a peugeot 3008 .... will it fit in the boot ? any advice is much appreciated ....

posts.body: Can you take your car to the pram shop/Mothercare and try it out?

posts.body:
It has the folded dimensions on the Mothercare website.

http://www.mothercare.com/Silver-Cross-Linear-Freeway-Pram-and-Pushchair/LK4534,default,pd.html

Folded - 102 cm by 40 cm by 29 cm.

posts.body: There are a regular stream of shoppers and shop staff outside our local Mothercare and Kiddicare trying various prams out to see if they fit in car boots - it's probably the best way to get a definitive answer if it'll fit or not.
